Total reflections outstanding; reduced in _reflectFee and read by _getCurrentSupply/_getRate.
Accumulated token fees; increased in _reflectFee.

Reduces _rTotal by rFee and increases _tFeeTotal; contains the unchecked-by-design subtraction path.
Payable receive hook accepting ETH (e.g. proceeds from router swaps), a potential reentrancy entrypoint.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the transfer origin into _transfer.
Caller-controlled sender flows into the internal _transfer accounting.
manualswap authorization is a direct msg.sender equality check against _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization is a direct msg.sender equality check against _feeAddrWallet1.
Constructor writes _owner from _msgSender(), establishing the privileged account.
Constructor privileges flow from the deployer caller.
block.timestamp drives the cooldown gate and the cooldown[to] write in _transfer.
cooldown[to] is set to block.timestamp + 40 seconds, making the limiter miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer recipient is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer amount is forwarded to _transfer.
Sender flows through to the standard transfer accounting.
Recipient flows through to the standard transfer accounting.
Amount flows through to the standard transfer accounting.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap input amount.
tokenAmount is handed to the external router swap call.
amount is handed to the external ETH transfer.
bots_ entries are written into the bots blacklist mapping.
notbot clears an entry in the bots blacklist mapping.
manualswap contract balance is used as the swap amount.
tAmount is the input of the value-derivation routine.
transfer dispatches into _transfer.
transferFrom dispatches into _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
approve calls _approve.
_transfer terminates by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth while executing, exposing the swap path to reentry.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee right after the swap, sending ETH out mid-execution.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard derives values via _getValues.
_transferStandard takes the team fee.
_transferStandard reflects the fee.
_reflectFee executes the _rTotal subtraction.
The subtraction result is written back into _rTotal.
openTrading calls createPair on the factory.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract's ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
manualswap triggers an unguarded external swap of the contract balance.
manualsend drains the ETH balance to the fee wallet.
balanceOf converts reflections via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection obtains the rate from _getRate.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_getRate depends on _getCurrentSupply for the supply pair.
_setMaxTxAmount (onlyOwner) rewrites the limit used by the timestamp cooldown.
setCooldownEnabled (onlyOwner) toggles the timestamp-dependent cooldown branch.
setBots (onlyOwner) writes the blacklist used to gate transfers.
delBot (onlyOwner) mutates the blacklist used to gate transfers.
renounceOwnership (onlyOwner) clears the privileged owner state variable.
The router swap returns ETH to the contract, re-entering the receive hook.
The outward ETH transfer can trigger receiver fallback logic during the transfer flow.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer.recipient is only a placeholder data carrier into _transfer.
transfer.amount is only a placeholder data carrier into _transfer.
_transfer.from is a positional argument consumed by the accounting routine.
_transfer.to is a positional argument consumed by the accounting routine.
_transfer.amount is a positional argument consumed by the accounting routine.
_transfer.contractTokenBalance is a transient local passed straight into swapTokensForEth.
swapTokensForEth.tokenAmount is only used as the external swap argument.
sendETHToFee.amount is only used as the external ETH transfer argument.
setBots.bots_ is the loop input of the owner-only blacklist setter.
delBot.notbot is the sole input of the owner-only blacklist remover.
manualswap.contractBalance is a transient local fed into the swap routine.
_getValues.tAmount is a transient argument of the value-derivation routine.
